page.layout: One page of text; running head at top; heading lines centred; verse lines in the centre; a signature mark at the lower right corner. No margin notes.

main_text.head: AD MISSAM, DE PIETATE
COLLECTA.
main_text.p: Interveniat pro nobis, quæsumus Domine Jesu Christe, apud tuam sanctam clementiam nunc & in horâ mortis nostræ, piissima virgo Maria, mater tua, cujus sacratissimam animam in horâ benedictæ passionis tuæ doloris gladius pertransivit, & in gloriosissima Resurrectione tuâ ingens gaudiû lætificavit:
main_text.head: EX SEPTEM GAUDIIS corporalibus beatæ virginis Mariæ.

page.notes: Lower right corner shows a faint signature mark "Ei" (partly illegible). Some words in the first lines of the verse are overprinted by show-through and are uncertain; the rendering of "Gaude virgo, stella matris" and similar lines follows the most legible reading. The line "Nos emunda à peccatis" is partly obscured.
